title: Introduction and Architectural Overview
summary: Sets the context for a scalable ride‑hailing platform in India, outlines performance goals and technology stack.

title: High‑Performance Runtime Environment
summary: Discusses the choice of Bun for core microservices and Python/FastAPI for AI workloads, with performance comparison.

title: Service Communication via gRPC and Protocol Buffers
summary: Describes the use of gRPC/Protobuf for low‑latency, type‑safe inter‑service calls.

title: Event‑Driven Backbone: Apache Kafka
summary: Explains Kafka’s role in telemetry ingestion, multi‑tier event processing, and exactly‑once semantics.

title: Hybrid Database Strategy
summary: Details the combined use of PostgreSQL, ScyllaDB, Redis, and HE3DB for ACID consistency, high‑throughput, caching, and encrypted analytics.

title: Dynamic Pricing Engine
summary: Presents the pricing formula, variables, external triggers, and AI models used for surge calculation.

title: Pricing Data Schema and Analytics
summary: Defines transactional tables (Trips, Payments, Driver Earnings) and promotional tables for user‑savings analytics.

title: Abstract Mapping Layer (Google vs. Ola)
summary: Shows the strategy‑pattern implementation that enables runtime switching between mapping providers.

title: Scaling Strategies and Fault Isolation
summary: Covers horizontal scaling, stateless services, distributed locking, regional fault domains, and Kafka MirrorMaker replication.

title: Driver Telemetry Management
summary: Describes down‑sampling, dead‑reckoning, and GPS cleaning to handle network volatility.

title: Pricing Fairness and Compliance
summary: Discusses surge caps, fare transparency, algorithmic fairness, and driver incentive mechanisms.

title: Conclusions
summary: Summarizes the architectural blueprint, emphasizing performance, AI integration, and fairness.

title: References
summary: Lists all cited works, articles, and resources supporting the design.
